metadata.description: Skills that make AI-written prose less annoying and better sourced.

plugins.name: prose-style
plugins.description: Catch LLM writing tics in prose (a mechanical checker plus judgement checks) and keep a growing personal house style.

plugins.name: claim-sourcing
plugins.description: Make every claim in a draft rest on evidence a reader could check: claim ledger, artefact checks, overclaim hunting, skeptic audits, cross-model refutation.

plugins.name: publish-gate
plugins.description: The order of checks before prose leaves the machine, a fresh-reader pass with only the audience's context, and a leak checker for local paths, hashes and internal names.
